title: How do I archive a survey?
intent: This article explains how to archive a survey for long-term storage.
short_answer: To archive a survey, select it from your Forms list and choose 'Archive'. Archiving moves the survey and its contributions to cold storage, freeing up resources. Archived surveys can be restored later.
prerequisites: Survey should ideally be unpublished or inactive
procedure: Select the survey from the Forms list.
The system creates an archive package containing the survey and contributions.
The survey is moved to the Archived Surveys section.
important_conditions: Archiving moves the survey to a separate storage area.
Archived surveys cannot be edited until restored.
The archive includes survey structure and contributions.
Missing files during archiving generate a warning.
Archived surveys are listed in a separate 'Archived Surveys' view.
The archiving feature must be enabled via the server configuration flag.
troubleshooting: 'Warning - Problem during archiving': Some files could not be found. The archive may be incomplete.
